summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its participation in the Nasdaq Closing Bell Ceremony on April 20, 2026. The event celebrates the company's recent listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market, which began trading on January 26, 2026. No financial terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics are disclosed. The filing is purely a ceremonial announcement and does not involve any M&A, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. As a foreign private issuer routine current report, it is categorized as Other.
